props.name: src
props.description: The current avatar’s URL. Omit for initials.

props.name: name
props.description: Whose avatar — drives the initials and the accessible names.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new image, already cropped when `crop` is on, or `null` when it is removed. Return a promise to show progress; a rejection puts the previous avatar back and shows its message.

props.name: accept
props.description: Accepted MIME types, as the file input’s `accept`.

props.name: crop
props.description: Ask for a square crop before handing the image over.

props.name: removable
props.description: Allow removing the avatar back to initials.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.
